skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn my photos into a 30-second promo video with music and text — and get...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Maker AI Free — create shareable promo videos from your images or clips in under a minute.
- No software or subscription required: upload MP4, MOV, JPG, or PNG files up to 500MB.
- Free anonymous access: automatically obtain a token for 100 credits valid for 7 days.
- Fully automated cloud video rendering with support for music, text overlays, and export to 1080p MP4.
- Simple, prompt-driven workflow ideal for content creators and small businesses.
- Common actions (upload, edit, check status, export) mapped to natural language commands for ease of use.
